Name: `MULTI_PLANE`
Description: Enable multi-plane in HWC. Unset to disable.

Name: `MULTI_PLANE_NUM`
Description: Set number of multi-plane in HWC. Unset to use default.

Name: `HWC_PREFER_MODE`
Description: Set to `0` to support all display modes. Unset to use default.

Name: `CONNECTOR_ID`
Description: Specify Connector ID. Unset to use default.

Name: `MODE_ID`
Description: Specify Mode ID. Unset to use default.

Name: `MULTI_REFRESH_RATE`
Description: Enable multi refresh rate for the system. Unset to disable.
